_note: v4 declared knob menu (A3/AM1). Effort is NOT a knob: medium for every call. One-factor mutations of the tip draw one knob and one value != the tip's. Stage 1 = settings applied per request by the client; Stage 2 adds the weight knobs, read on the W engine (Surgeon apply/revert, vharness ops). Patch size / kernel and v3-trace directions / verbosity are out (coordinator 11-10). Value sets for weight knobs = v3 grid ranges.

min_image_tokens.what: every image is upscaled to at least this many visual tokens (null = the processor's own minimum)

max_image_tokens.what: larger images are downscaled to at most this many visual tokens

scale.what: multiply one block's output projection by alpha

skip.what: zero one block's output (the residual passes through)

attn_temp.what: scale attention logits of layers first..last by 1/alpha

weights_band_cells._note: arm B weight cells on engine W (S2-C moved into generation 4, coordinator 11-10): scalar knobs by layer band, a few values each, in the W worker's edit forms (engine_api.md §7, w_worker.py surgeon_edit; layers [a, b] inclusive). Each cell is one global candidate of author B, drawn blind, at most once per tip; cells found in <root>/cells/*/cells.json join the menu as a second group.

ranges_B._note: AM16 item 4 (coordinator 11-10): arm B's blind menus as ranges; proposer menus ('settings' above) stay byte-identical. Engine facts: an image token is a 32 x 32 pixel patch (patch 16 x merge 2, engine_v4/common.py FACTOR 32); the processor's own minimum is 65,536 px = 64 tokens and the engine's limit 16,777,216 px = 16,384 tokens (STOCK_MIN_PX / STOCK_MAX_PX); the model has layers 0-63. CHOICES, NOT ENGINE FACTS: the temperature interval and the weight dose interval below (they bracket the earlier value lists: temperature .6-1.2, doses .1-.3).

weights.fact: layers: engine; dose interval: choice (alpha = 1 + signed dose, log-uniform |dose|); ops: the W worker's scalar forms with a dose (skip has none)
